jamie: Final prep — EU midnight change window starts in 20m. Drop go/no-go items here and call out rollback owners. I'll compile the flight deck. :rocket:

arjun: Autoscaler warmup done, dedicated pool at 80% warm. Canary traffic slice ready (5%).

sophie: Release notes: https://redwood.docs/internal/releases/3.2.4 — features + known issues. Flagging payments-inline feature flag will be enabled in 10m.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary-started release/v3.2.4 -> eu-cluster. slice=5%.

maya: Canary tests started, smoke-green for generation latency < 120ms.

arjun: Pin for hotfix branch pinned to runtime v2026-03-17-gpu. pin-id: pin-9843. If rollback needed use:
```
redwood rollback --cluster eu --release release/v3.2.4 --to pin-9831
```

ops-lead: Rollback owners: arjun (infra), maya (ops), jamie (product). Oncall is @sophie for pager.

jamie: Can we confirm observability retention is set to 30m for this window? We need token-level traces for first 10k requests.

sophie: Confirmed. Traces streaming to console with retention=30m. Alert thresholds: error rate > 1% or latency p95 > 350ms.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary-pass OK. metrics: errors 0.12%, p95 98ms. progressing to 20% in 5m.

maya: I'll watch traffic shift. If p95 spikes >200ms I will pause and escalate.

jamie: Go for gradual rollout — proceed to 20%. :thumbsup:

arjun: Noted. Documenting rollback decision: if model quality regresses or cost per token jumps >30% revert to cpu-quantized variant.

sophie: I'll post short release note to #general when 50% is reached.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] progress update: 20% slice applied. next milestone 50%.

maya: Holding radar, will ping if anything anomalous. :eyes:

jamie: Thanks team — flight deck copy saved: https://redwood.internal/flight-decks/3.2.4-eu-midnight

sophie: 20m mark reached, initiating flag flip in 5m. :alarm_clock:

arjun: final ack from infra: all good. go/no-go: GO.

jamie: Go.
